project_title: Leonida Explorer - Seamless Map Feathering & Safari Masking
design_intent: Elegante, nahtlose Verschmelzung der Leonida-Karte mit dem pink-violetten Miami-Sonnenuntergang-Hintergrund über 4-seitige CSS-Maskierung (mask-image / -webkit-mask-image) ohne harte Bildkanten, unter vollständiger Erhaltung aller Landmassen (inkl. südwestlicher Insel), interaktiver Pins, Gesten und Safari-Kompatibilität.

surfaces.name: map_canvas_surface
surfaces.guarantee: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) with bg-background/60 and oklch tint

entry_surfaces./karte: Vivid sunset skyline background with seamless feathered floating map canvas, neon glass controls, and bottom navigation
entry_surfaces./entdecken: Miami sunset background with feed of approved Leonida spots and filter chips
entry_surfaces./beitrag: Contribution form with card-style map coordinate picker
entry_surfaces./community: Community leaderboard and badges with glass neon cards
entry_surfaces./profil: Player profile with level badge, statistics and submitted spots

map_feathering_specification.goal: Nahtlose 4-seitige Ausblendung der Bildkanten der Leonida-Karte in den Sonnenuntergang-Hintergrund, ohne Inselteile zu verdecken und ohne harte Ecken.
map_feathering_specification.feathering_technique: Dual CSS Masking with -webkit-mask-image and mask-image utilizing linear/radial gradients or combined directional gradients
safari_ios_rules: Always declare both -webkit-mask-image and mask-image for full WebKit (iOS Safari) compatibility.

Never apply mask-image directly on the interactive TransformComponent wrapper or spot markers container, which would clip pins or interfere with touch hit-testing. Apply it specifically to the element or a dedicated image-only wrapper.
Use gradient color stops that preserve 100% opacity over the central 82%-88% of the map, and fade smoothly to transparent (0%) only over the outer 6%-10% ocean border.
Ensure the southwest island (südwestliche Insel) and southern coastlines stay well within the 100% opacity zone.
Remove hard rectangular shadow boxes or heavy rectangular drop shadows from the image (replace with ambient radial glow behind the map or soft luminous blend).

css_mask_implementation.mask_css_rule: mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 92% at 50% 50%, black 72%, transparent 98%); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 92% at 50% 50%, black 72%, transparent 98%);
css_mask_implementation.alternative_directional_mask: mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 6%, black 94%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, black 5%, black 95%, transparent 100%); mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-mask-composite: source-in;
css_mask_implementation.ambient_glow: Soft radial gradient behind the map with blur-3xl (oklch(0.6 0.2 240 / 0.35) and oklch(0.7 0.3 345 / 0.25)) to naturally fuse ocean water with Miami sunset.

instructions: In variant='floating', remove hard shadow classes like shadow-[0_0_28px_...] from the element that create rectangular edge artifacts.
Apply soft CSS masking to the map image ().
Keep pins and click handlers outside the masked image element so pins are always 100% opaque and fully clickable at any zoom level.
Preserve react-zoom-pan-pinch gesture support (pinch, pan, wheel, double click), initial center view, and minScale/maxScale logic.
Preserve layer toggle (showPins), reset view (Maximize), and zoomIn/zoomOut buttons with high-contrast glassmorphism.
Keep AppShell vividBg set to true for the rich Miami sunset skyline backdrop.
Maintain safe area insets (safe-top and safe-bottom) for iPhone notch and home indicator.
Ensure search input, filter modal, stats bar, and 'Fundort vorschlagen' CTA button remain fully accessible and functional.

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_compliance: All text and button labels maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast against their respective tinted glass or solid background.
accessibility_and_contrast.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch targets on all interactive controls (Zoom, Reset, Layers, Profile, Filter, Search clear).
accessibility_and_contrast.prefers_reduced_motion: Support smooth transitions while respecting reduced motion media query.
accessibility_and_contrast.testing_attributes: All key controls and containers must maintain strict data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='map-floating', data-testid='map-image', data-testid='map-locate-button', data-testid='map-pin-*').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT alter backend, Supabase, database schema, demo data, badges, user profiles, or routing logic.
2. Do NOT replace the map image file (src/assets/leonida-map.jpg). Use the existing high-res asset.
3. Focus solely on polishing MapCanvas.tsx and related map styling in styles.css to achieve the seamless feathered edge blending with the pink-violet sunset.
4. Test that the full Leonida island, including the southwest island and southern keys/coastlines, remains crisp, sharp and completely visible with zero cutoff.
5. Ensure iOS Safari and iPhone touch gestures (pinch-to-zoom, pan, tap) work smoothly without any glitch or blocked events.
